source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Give a **Unified Force** a single army-rule scope. For DRUKHARI, both armies contribute to a common **Pain Token** pool, with each earning tokens under **Power from Pain**. Armies outside a Unified Force apply their army rules separately. A Unified Force can use one set of **Detachment rules** across both armies when both players picked the same Detachment. In other cases, a player's Detachment rules apply only to enemy units and that player's own units. Between different Detachments in a Unified Force, a shared faction keyword and an otherwise eligible target still leave an ally's unit outside that player's [Detachment Stratagems](vsdata:core-rule/event-companion.using-stratagems-15-01) and other Detachment benefits.

example.earning: each army applies the rule’s trigger
